_doc: The snow ground of the winter landscape (bead bzc.87, docs/art/classes/grounds.md). After bzc.83: no chibi style layer (it turns a texture into a character), no words 'texture' or 'tile' (pixen draws grids), pixflux 400 x 400 flat shading for a 5-cell long-period base. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead. '@name' values come from shared.

shared.snow3: Subject: a wide flat field of smooth fresh snow seen from directly above, filling the whole image edge to edge: soft white #e4eaf1 with large soft, slightly bluer wind drifts #d3dce8 that blend gently into each other and a few faint thin curved wind lines, very calm, quiet and low in contrast, the same everywhere.
shared.snow: Subject: a wide flat field of fresh snow seen from directly above, filling the whole image edge to edge: soft white #e6ecf2 with gentle pale blue-grey #ccd7e3 wind drifts and shallow ripples, a few faint blue shadows #b9c7d8 in the hollows and a few tiny scattered grey pebbles peeking through, very calm, quiet and low in contrast, the same everywhere.
shared.snow2: Subject: a wide flat snowfield seen from directly above, filling the whole image edge to edge: packed snow of soft blue-white #dde6ef with large soft slightly bluer drifts #c8d4e2 and slightly whiter patches #edf2f7, a few tiny grey-brown stones and dry grass stalks poking through here and there, very calm and low in contrast, the same everywhere.
